drafts.title: 🖤 THE BRIDE WHO WAITED FOR THE DRAGON
drafts.text:
Some love stories outlive the kingdoms that tried to end them 🖤🐉👇

🖤 THE BRIDE WHO WAITED FOR THE DRAGON 🖤

She waited where the embers sleep,
a promise only stone could keep.
A hundred winters, still she stood,
until his wings broke through the wood.

Made with Grok Imagine 🎬
Want the prompt? Comment DRAGON 👇

Poetry by Patrick's Place
drafts.video_tip: 9:16, 10s. Second 0: close-up of a pale bride in a torn black veil, snow on her eyelashes, eyes opening slowly. Pull back to show her standing alone in a frozen dead forest beside a stone altar. Trees crack, a huge black dragon bursts through the branches and lowers its head to her hand; end on her forehead touching its snout as embers swirl around them.
